children: Bluerock Homes Trust announced two financing actions tied to a Northern California sale-leaseback transaction. The company issued a $33.1 million secured, 13.0% coupon, 36-month loan to BR HPE ZC Investment Co to fund Class II Interests in a Delaware Statutory Trust, with repayment expected from a private placement of Class I Interests. In addition, Bluerock provided a non-recourse carveout guaranty and hazardous materials indemnity supporting a $309.98 million Senior A-1 Note at 6.54%, earning $125,000 per year in fees, up to $625,000.
Agreement 1: Bluerock Homes Trust Extends $33.1M Secured Loan at 13% to BR HPE ZC Investment
: Support acquisition financing and planned syndication of trust interests
Agreement 2: Bluerock Homes Trust Issues Non-Recourse Carveout Guaranty, Earning Up to $625K in Fees
